'''Kuat Systems Engineering''', or '''KSE''', was a short-lived subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] created in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
[[File:Jsf_negvv.png|thumb|left|180px|KSE manufactured the highly advanced [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite'' Jedi starfighter]]]]
Kuat Systems Engineering was established towards the end of the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The company produced a few well-designed but poorly marketed starships, including the [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]], the [[Wayfarer-class medium freighter/Legends|''Wayfarer''-class medium transport]] and the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]]. The company's lack of commericial success was its downfall. Kuat Systems Engineering was reorganized back under the Kuat Drive Yards company banner and dedicated solely to the after-market starship upgrade kit market.<ref name="EGVV" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], KSE was sold off to a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] loyalists. It was later revealed that the loyalists were really [[Vaathkree (species)|Vaathkree]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] with strong ties to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGVV" /> At this time, KSE products were costly.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021017web|text=''Arms & Equipment Guide'' Extras!}}</ref>
